sv.title: Sabunis råd till C: Det slet sönder oss
sv.summary: Liberalernas tidigare partiledare Nyamko Sabuni varnar C för en uppslitande intern process i regeringsfrågan. ”Det blev en av de mest plågsamma erfarenheterna under mitt politiska liv”, skriver hon på Expressen debatt.

en.title: Sabuni's advice to C: It tore us apart
en.summary: Former Liberals leader Nyamko Sabuni warns the Centre Party of a draining internal process over the government question. "It became one of the most painful experiences of my political life," she writes in an Expressen debate article.
